RagShortTexts: Burgundian followers gather along woods and rivers.
Food and return dates determine how long they remain.

Variants.Content: Followers gather along woods and rivers. Food and return dates set endurance; a route home matters to morale as much as another forward site.

Burgundian followers gather along woods and rivers. These forces remain limited by food, rest and loads; vanguard speed does not represent the whole column. Food and return dates determine how long they remain.

Food and return dates determine how long they remain. Usable strength includes supply, home guards and exits; concentration reduces another reserve. Burgundian followers gather along woods and rivers.
Burgundian followers gather along woods and rivers. Fighters come from households; prolonged loss of labor or animals weakens the next levy. Food and return dates determine how long they remain.
Food and return dates determine how long they remain. Repair, carrying and care also use people, while daily supply continues after troops pass. Burgundian followers gather along woods and rivers.
